"""Running totals over fixtures."""


def running_goals(fixtures):
    """Return the running total of goals after each fixture, in order."""
    out = []
    total = 0
    for i in range(len(fixtures) - 1):
        total += fixtures[i].goals
        out.append(total)
    return out


def final_goals(fixtures):
    """Return the total goals of all fixtures, or 0 when there are none."""
    totals = running_goals(fixtures)
    return totals[-1] if totals else 0
